the_one_defect.claim: the Brca1 row is present in the siBrca1 lane of panel D and in the Bard1-/- lane of panel E
the_one_defect.finding: Panel D is correct — present but clearly weaker in the siB1 lane. Panel E is not: at 700 dpi the Input Brca1 row shows no detectable band in the Bard1 -/- lane against two clear bands in the +/+ lanes, consistent with the paper's own statement that Brca1 stability is dramatically reduced without Bard1.
the_one_defect.direction: UNDERSHOOT — the clause exists to weaken the paper's Brca1-independence control; because Brca1 is undetectable in that lane, panel E is a STRONGER control than the reading credits. This is the silent-false-negative direction, not overshoot.
the_one_defect.disposition: PROPOSED, not repaired. A persisted locator is a tracked revision with its own R4 precondition.

refinements: R1 27869163 entry 49: proposition true of the artefact, but the quoted string is a header cell that carries none of its content; re-anchor to PRIOR_THERAPY_RADIATION_TYPE and the BRACHYTHERAPY/RADIOSURGERY values.

R2 27869163 entry 53: the standing validator WARN. The dual cell_line declaration is the paper's own unreconciled discrepancy and is honest, but the WARN should be answered in the manifest rather than left standing.

R3 35409089 entry 50: the Figure 5 zero-mark finding is TRUE and confirmed in the render, but its stated argument (a vector extraction returning 0 marks) cannot establish it — page 8 also returns 0 vector marks while Figure 4 carries real raster marks. Keep the finding, replace the reasoning with the legend comparison: Figures 3 and 4 declare the asterisk key, Figure 5 does not.

R4 35409089 entries 39-40: the snippets are table-cell concatenations, not authored character sequences, and verify only through _match_key's alphanumeric folding. Propositions fully supported by Table 1.
R5 35409089 entry 57: proposition names empty vector as the only negative control in panels D and E; panel E's control is IgG, exactly as the entry's own snippet says.
R6 35409089 entry 59: the four mark sequences are exactly right and 7 marks are N.S., but the page carries 15 PANEL marks plus one caption-key *** in the body font, not 16 panel marks.
W6_RESULT.coverage_assessment: HONEST on every declared field of both receipts. limitations: not_present verified by section inventory (29 and 38 sections, no Limitations section, 0 occurrences of 'limitation' in the 2017 body). tables: read verified (one table-wrap each, quoted rows extracted cell by cell). supplementary: read is genuinely 'images inspected' and not captions_only in both. figures: read verified — every declared figure artefact's native dimensions reproduce exactly (24 and 9 artefacts measured). ONE FINDING (C1): 15 of the 43 .ppt blips are reachable through no declared artefact (28 are, 5 individually plus 2 plus 11 via montage_S3 plus 10 via montage_S4), although the montage_S4 note claims every deposited image was inspected; an undeclared montage_S6a.png sits on disk, so the declaration is what is missing rather than necessarily the looking. I inspected all 15 myself: raw annotated blot films from Supplementary Figures 3-6, none reversing or qualifying anything. Inside that gap is the substantive omission ranked first: Supplementary Figure 5, the reverse-direction Myc/IgG co-IP that confirms the Brca1-deletion mapping, carries no locator at all though the body cites it for exactly entry 10's claim — and entry 55 finds the MAIN figure's IgG control positive in lane C, so the one panel that could corroborate or break that mapping is the one nobody anchored.
W6_RESULT.declared_absences_tested: All held as real absences rather than failed searches: no resection assay in the 2017 paper (14 'resection' occurrences, all conceptual or citational); no densitometry in either paper; no statistics in the 2022 Figure 5 (confirmed in pixels at 300 dpi AND by legend comparison); no reconciliation of the HEK293/H1299 host-line discrepancy (all 7+4+4 occurrences read in context); no wild-type karyogram and no circle annotation in Supplementary Figure 1 although the legend says circles; no hedging glyph anywhere in the 2022 Figure 6 (0 '?' in the text layer and none in the raster, the whole panel being raster).
W6_RESULT.independent_re_derivations: The .ppt text layer re-derived from the OLE stream (513 text atoms, 6991 chars) with a zero-line set difference against the declared surface in both directions; 43 image blips counted independently by signature (36 PNG + 7 JPEG); both .xls dumps checked by dimension (542x37, 158x31) and by string cross-check inside the BIFF bytes.
near_misses_caught_before_recording: My own snippet matcher reported 2 MISSes on the 2022 table entries that the validator had passed. I suspected my pattern first, read _quote_matches/_match_key, and found the alphanumeric folding — a snippet-form refinement, not a defect. Reporting them as unverified would have been a false positive.

My per-figure legend check returned 'no asterisk key' for EVERY legend including Figure 3, which certainly carries one. My 1400-character window truncated the long legends. Re-run with full windows: Figures 3 and 4 carry the key, Figures 1, 2, 5 and 6 do not — which is what actually supports the Figure 5 finding.

My first band renders of the Figure 5 page stopped at y=470 and showed only the panel tops, which would have left the zero-mark claim unverified while looking checked. Re-rendered the full panels at 300 dpi before recording.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: No phase packet exists for this task, so no firewall names withheld artefacts.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Applied the convention the rest of the batch used: the dossiers, commit candidates and M4b comparison notes for both PMIDs stayed closed until the verdicts were written and committed. The two manifests and the two receipts were read, being the reading's own record and the object of the task.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_it_is_safe: It preserves producer != verifier independence at its strongest reading while leaving the object of verification reachable.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Opening them first would have let the producer's conclusions shape the verdicts, which is the one thing an independent pass may not do.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: PIL/Pillow absent; figure content is checkable by neither evidence_presence.py nor the manifest validator, which verify digests and structure, not pixels.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Rendered and cropped from the digest-verified PDFs and PNGs with PyMuPDF 1.28.2 at 160-700 dpi, in the scratchpad only.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_it_is_safe: It reads the same declared, digest-matching artefacts through a different decoder, writes nothing into the repository and installs no tooling.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: All 31 figure propositions could only have been accepted on the producer's word, which is exactly what an independent verification may not do.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: No python-pptx, olefile or xlrd in this deployment for the legacy .ppt and the two .xls artefacts.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Best-effort independent re-derivation: OLE text atoms scanned directly, image signatures counted directly, spreadsheet dumps checked by dimension and by string cross-check in the BIFF bytes. Declared as best-effort rather than as a parser result.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_it_is_safe: It is an independent path to the same facts and its limits are stated.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: The derived .txt surfaces and the 43-blip count would have rested on the producer's declaration alone.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The network-sourced manifest blocks (group_assessment, field_density, retraction_check) are not re-derivable offline in this pass.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Judged the honesty and self-limitation of those declarations rather than their numbers, and excluded them from the per-proposition tally.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_it_is_safe: Each block states its own limits — author-name queries not ORCID-disambiguated, screen clean but incomplete, load-bearing unread dependencies named — so the failure mode being guarded against is a silent screen, and these screens are not silent.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Re-deriving them would settle metadata that changes no scientific conclusion here.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Three of my own checks returned EMPTY or failing results on text and panels that existed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Suspected my own pattern before the text in every case, and re-measured: the matcher fallback, the truncated legend window, the too-short figure band. None was recorded as a defect.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_it_is_safe: It is the rule that protects the truth, applied to my own instruments; three false negatives would otherwise have entered this report as findings.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Two false positives against sound locators and one unverified claim reported as checked.
